Acme Everyday T-shirt

Product description

This everyday T-shirt is designed for adult men and women for casual daily wear. Its soft cotton fabric provides breathable comfort.

Selected configuration: Medium, US sizing, Navy. Includes one T-shirt. This product is offered in a single configuration.

Selected size: Medium (US). Selected color: Navy.

Fabric composition: 100% cotton. Regular fit through the chest and body. Short sleeves and a crew neckline.

Specifications and care

Fabric weight: 180 gsm. Garment measurements for selected Medium: chest 100 cm, length 70 cm. Made in Portugal.

Machine wash cold with like colors.

Measure your chest in cm and compare with the garment chart. Choose Medium for a 100 cm chest garment measurement, allowing room for your fit preference.

This product costs USD 25.00. This product is in stock.
